testId: tests/webstore/CartCheckoutPage/CartCheckoutPageTest.spec.ts > SAN-019 SAN-027 EDG-008 SAN-015 SAN-005 SCN-004 EDG-009: Empty cart message, PLP link and recovery

scenario.summary: A created Sales Rep (Shop As) with an empty cart sees 'Your cart is empty' with a PLP link and no sections; after adding two lines, editing a quantity and removing both lines the empty state returns; re-adding from the PLP shows the page again. A created Market Coordinator sees the empty state after removing the last line, before and after refresh.
steps: Sign in on the storefront (config webstoreURL, /login) with the tester's own Admin account (config adminUsername / adminPassword, from env ADMIN_USERNAME / ADMIN_PASSWORD); the Web Admin Dashboard (/admin) opens
In Web Admin open Users, find the created Sales Rep by its user name (@salesRep.userName) and choose Shop As; the storefront opens as that user with the impersonation header
Click Cart in the Header with the empty cart; read the message; check no checkout sections and no Place Order (SAN-019, SAN-005 steps 1-2)
Click the PLP link in the message; check the PLP opens with products (SAN-019 step 4, SAN-005 step 3)
Apply a Category filter on the PLP and check the list is filtered (SAN-005 step 4; see P6)
Open the PDP /product/{@product.parentProductId}; the size grid is shown; enter 1 for @product.variant1Attr1 and 1 for @product.variant2Attr1 and click Add to Cart
Open the Header Cart; change the quantity of @product.variant1Sku from 1 to 2 (no price shown); remove @product.variant2Sku (SAN-015 steps 1-3)
Remove the remaining line (SAN-015 step 4, SAN-027, EDG-008 step 2); check the empty state (EDG-008 step 3)
Click the PLP link; check the PLP opens (EDG-008 step 4)
Click Cart in the Header with the cart still empty; check the empty state with the PLP link (EDG-008 step 5)
From the PLP open @product.name and click Add to Cart with 1 for @product.variant1Attr1; check the Header cart count updates (SCN-004 steps 3-4)
Click the Header Cart; check all sections, the new line and no prices (SCN-004 step 5)

End Impersonation; In Web Admin open Users, find the created Market Coordinator by its user name (@coordinator.userName) and choose Shop As; the storefront opens as that user with the impersonation header
Open the PDP /product/{@product.parentProductId}; the size grid is shown; enter 1 for @product.variant1Attr1 and click Redeem Now; open the page from the Header Cart (EDG-009 step 1)
Remove the only line; check the page without refreshing, then refresh and check again (EDG-009 steps 2-4)
stateChanges: The Sales Rep and Market Coordinator users and their allotments are created for the test by their collections and deleted at teardown
Cart lines added, edited and removed by the test
The Sales Rep ends with one line in the cart (removed with the user)
assertions: With an empty cart the page shows 'Your cart is empty' with a link to the PLP (link text open, analysis Q12)
With an empty cart Address and Contact, Questionnaire, Delivery, Order Summary and Place Order are not shown (an order cannot be placed)
The link opens the PLP with the user's products; the Category filter still works
Changing a quantity from 1 to 2 updates it without showing a price; a removed line disappears
Removing the last line switches the page to the empty state with the PLP link
Re-adding a product from the PLP and opening the Header Cart shows all sections with the new line and no prices
For the Market Coordinator the empty state (message, PLP link, no Place Order) shows right after removing the last line and again after refresh
evidence: Jira BMP-94 (story, FSD section 'Shopping Cart and Checkout', work/stories/BMP-94/input/) and manual cases SAN-019, SAN-027, EDG-008, SAN-015, SAN-005, SCN-004, EDG-009 (work/stories/BMP-94/input/BMP-94-testcases.md)

work/stories/BMP-94/analysis.md section 6: every role test signs in with the tester's own Admin account and reaches the created user through Shop As (user decision 2026-11-26); created users never sign in with a password, so 'signed in as <role>' in the cases is reached through Shop As

PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_SIZE_GRID (existing BNJM size-grid products, no price rule: BNJM variants are priced 0.00; user decision 2026-11-27) replaces the hardcoded /product/798 (BM05) and size Small of the cases; on qa product 798 (SKU BM05) is configured by attribute Size (ZnodePimConfigureProductAttribute -> PimAttributeId 129, AttributeCode Size), so variantAttributes = Size

Allotments: BIWW Allocations custom table, linked to the rep only by SalesRepEmail (analysis section 9); one ALLOTMENT_OF_USER_FOR_VARIANT need per variant the test enters, quantity = the highest quantity the test reaches for it
Category filter: the category name to filter by waits for an output categoryName on PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_SIZE_GRID (P6, not built)
SAN-015 'two different items' are two lines (two sizes of the product); SCN-004 'any allotted product' is the same allotted product
